negative_reviews.author: Foodie girl
negative_reviews.text:
偽寿司屋です。おすすめしません。
美味しくない。日本食で働いておいてアジア人差別をする最低な店員がいます。
I went to this restaurant with my Asian friends. I visited because the website menu showed an “omakase aburi sushi” option, which I was interested in trying. However, when we arrived, it was not available on the actual menu.

I asked a male staff member about it, and he told me that if we requested it, the chef could prepare an omakase with some aburi (seared) sushi. When the female server came over, I explained that we would like to order omakase with aburi sushi. She asked which pieces we wanted to be seared, which was reasonable. However, when I asked, “Which sushi pieces would normally be selected?” because it was omakase, she did not check with the chef or try to help. Instead, she replied bluntly, “It’s omakase,” and left it at that.

The restaurant was not busy at all — there were only two other tables occupied — yet this server repeatedly came back almost every minute asking if we had decided what to order. The constant pressure, combined with her unfriendly attitude, made the experience very uncomfortable.

As a Japanese person, I found this level of service especially disappointing from a restaurant that presents itself as serving Japanese cuisine. I believe staff should have a better understanding of Japanese dining culture, especially the meaning of “omakase,” where customers trust the chef’s selection.

The most frustrating part was that when we paid using a certain service, her attitude suddenly changed. She became friendly, smiled, and even asked us to leave a review. So here I am, leaving an honest one.

Unfortunately, the sushi itself was not good, and the sushi was not prepared by a Japanese chef. In my opinion, this felt more like a fake representation of Japanese sushi rather than an authentic sushi experience.

negative_reviews.author: Tom Honeyands
negative_reviews.text: 45 min wait once ordered. Other customers also visibly annoyed. Decent but not great food. Too busy impressing influencers at the bar. - and a fancy cup of dry ice smoking does not make it feel as high-end as they think it does. They did apologise and take off service charge. Not terrible, and reasonably priced. but not good enough. Better options nearby.
